name: HivePunk 547
subject: Aerodrome Finance
thesis: Aerodrome is a leading Base liquidity hub whose value flows through veAERO voting, emissions and bribes, but declining fees, emissions-dependent LP rewards and a planned merger make its durability uncertain. The pages support attention, not a conclusion that the model is sustainable.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: fullstack-development/blockchain-wiki-en has 0 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Aerodrome Finance launched in August 2023 as the primary liquidity hub/DEX on Base and gained 70% market share in less than one year.
claims.quote: Aerodrome Finance launched in August of ‘23 as the “primary liquidity hub/DEX” on Base, gaining a 70% market share in less than one year.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Aerodrome is a decentralized exchange on the Base network built on an AMM model and is a fork of Velodrome v2.
claims.quote: Aerodrome is a decentralized exchange (DEX) on the Base network built on an AMM model.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The Base network launched on August 9, 2023, and Aerodrome followed on August 28, 2023.
claims.quote: The Base network was launched on August 9, 2023, and the Aerodrome protocol followed on August 28, 2023.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Each week veAERO holders vote on which pools receive AERO rewards and liquidity providers in those pools earn those emissions.
claims.quote: Each week, veAERO holders vote on which pools should receive AERO rewards, and liquidity providers in those pools earn those emissions.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Per Aerodrome docs, 100% of protocol trading fees are paid to veAERO holders rather than LPs, and LPs are paid in AERO emissions.
claims.quote: Per Aerodrome docs, 100% of the protocol trading fees are paid to veAERO holders (rather than the LPs on Uniswap). Aerodrome Liquidity Providers are paid in AERO emissions/inflation (rather than trading fees on Uniswap).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Over the last 90 days Aerodrome generated $15.4m in fees, down 37% quarter on quarter, with 67% from Slipstream.
claims.quote: Over the last 90 days, Aerodrome has generated $15.4m in fees, down 37% q/q. 67% of the fees were generated by Slipstream (Aerodromes concentrated liquidity pool product).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Slipstream was launched in March 2024 to enable concentrated liquidity, bringing Uniswap v3-like functionality.
claims.quote: Only a year later, in March 2024, Slipstream was launched on top of Aerodrome to enable concentrated liquidity, bringing in Uniswap v3-like functionality.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Aerodrome launched on 28 August 2023 with no VC allocation or token sale, according to its docs About page.
claims.quote: According to the docs About page , Aerodrome launched on 28 August 2023 with no VC allocation or token sale.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The docs name Spearbit and ChainSecurity as auditors.
claims.quote: Audits Spearbit and ChainSecurity per the docs

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: In mid-2026 Aerodrome is expected to merge with Velodrome into a single system called Aero, powered by MetaDEX03.
claims.quote: In mid-2026, Aerodrome is expected to evolve from a Base-native DEX/liquidity marketplace into a cross-chain liquidity layer. The shift will merge Aerodrome and Velodrome into a single system called Aero, with Base serving as the operating hub.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: LP sustainability depends on continuing emissions and bribes because LPs do not receive the trading fees paid to veAERO holders.
claims.math: c5: 100% of trading fees to veAERO, LPs paid in emissions; c6: 21.7% of fees came from bribes, showing non-fee incentives are a material part of the model.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether Aerodrome has had an exploit or material security incident.
claims.missing: A verified exploit/security history check; the reviewer stated they did not research Aerodrome's exploit history.

risks: Fees are declining, down 37% quarter on quarter over the last 90 days.
Liquidity-provider returns depend on AERO emissions/inflation and bribes rather than trading fees, so yields are emissions-driven.
The veAERO voting and bribe mechanism is complex and takes effort to understand.
Success depends heavily on Base network adoption, protocol integrations and sustained trading volume.
DeFi risks cited include impermanent loss and smart contract vulnerabilities, and the planned Velodrome merge may change the product.
unknowns: Whether fullstack-development/blockchain-wiki-en is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
Whether Aerodrome has had an exploit or material security incident.: A verified exploit/security history check; the reviewer stated they did not research Aerodrome's exploit history.
wouldChangeMind: Verified audit reports and contract coverage for current Aerodrome contracts.
Independent verification of cumulative volume, fees and veAERO distributions claimed in the docs.
A completed, documented Velodrome merger with clear treatment of AERO and veAERO holders.
